chapterName: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
subject: Physics

concepts.name: Photon properties
concepts.oneLineSummary: Rest mass zero, speed c, neutral, E = hν = hc/λ.

concepts.name: Number of photons
concepts.oneLineSummary: N = E_light / (hν); intensity ∝ number of photons.

concepts.name: Photon momentum
concepts.oneLineSummary: p = h/λ = E/c.

concepts.name: Intensity of light
concepts.oneLineSummary: I = n E / (A t); for point source I ∝ 1/r².

concepts.name: Radiation pressure
concepts.oneLineSummary: P = I/c (absorption); P = 2I/c (reflection).

concepts.name: Photoelectric effect
concepts.oneLineSummary: Emission of electrons from metal surface by light; Einstein’s equation.

concepts.name: Work function and threshold frequency
concepts.oneLineSummary: φ0 = hν0; minimum energy/frequency to eject electron.

concepts.name: Stopping potential
concepts.oneLineSummary: K_max = e V0; independent of intensity.

concepts.name: Einstein photoelectric equation
concepts.oneLineSummary: K_max = hν – φ0 = hc(1/λ – 1/λ0).

concepts.name: Photocurrent vs intensity and frequency
concepts.oneLineSummary: Photocurrent ∝ intensity; K_max depends only on frequency.

concepts.name: de Broglie wavelength
concepts.oneLineSummary: λ = h/p = h/√(2m e V) for electrons.

concepts.name: Graphs of photoelectric effect
concepts.oneLineSummary: I–V curves for different intensity/frequency; V0–ν graph slope h/e.

concepts.name: One-to-one photon-electron interaction
concepts.oneLineSummary: Each photon interacts with a single electron.

concepts.name: Instantaneous nature of photoelectric effect
concepts.oneLineSummary: Emission occurs within ~10⁻⁹ s; no measurable time lag.

concepts.name: Matter waves
concepts.oneLineSummary: All matter has associated wave nature; de Broglie relation.

concepts.name: Davisson-Germer experiment
concepts.oneLineSummary: Confirmed electron diffraction; verified de Broglie wavelength.

concepts.name: Wave-particle duality
concepts.oneLineSummary: Light and matter exhibit both wave and particle properties.

concepts.name: Heisenberg uncertainty principle (basic)
concepts.oneLineSummary: Δx Δp ≥ h/4π; fundamental limit on simultaneous knowledge.

concepts.name: Photon mass and energy
concepts.oneLineSummary: Rest mass zero; moving mass = E/c².
